blocks.text: Jism ke non-specific difa mein proteins ke do bare groups hissa lete hain.

Liver (jigar) mein banne wale khaas proteins complement system banate hain. Is system mein darjan (12) se zyada mukhtalif proteins hain jo khoon mein ghair fa'al (inactive) haalat mein gardish karte rehte hain. Jab inhein koi microbe milta hai to yeh aik tarteeb se fa'al (active) hote hain: pehla protein doosre ko fa'al karta hai, doosra teesre ko, aur isi tarah aage. Aakhri paanch proteins microbe ki plasma membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain. Yeh complex microbe ki plasma membrane mein soorakh kar deta hai. Is liye maya (fluids) aur namkiyat (salts) microbe ke andar chale jate hain, microbe phool jata hai aur phat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Jaraseem ki membrane (lipid bilayer) ka hissa jise membrane attack complex ke proteins ne chhed diya hai. Bahar se mayi ke teer is surakh se jaraseem ke cytoplasm mein neeche jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.7: Complement system ke proteins aur un ka kaam (kitab ki Figure 21.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Interferons hifazati proteins ki aik aur qism hain jo jism ke difa mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Yeh virus-infected cells (jin cells mein virus aa chuka ho) chhorte hain. Yeh aas paas ke cells ko apna anti-viral (virus ke khilaf) difa barhane par aamada karte hain. Interferons proteins ki aik bari qism cytokines se talluq rakhte hain. Cytokines cells ke darmiyan paigham rasani (communication) ka kaam karte hain taa ke immune system ka hifazati difa shuru ho. Interferons doosre immune cells, maslan natural killer cells aur macrophages, ko bhi fa'al karte hain.

blocks.alt: Host cell 1: virus andar aata, us ka nucleic acid naye viruses banata jo bahar nikalte; DNA mein interferon genes chalu hote, messenger RNA banta aur interferon molecules chhoote. Yeh host cell 2 tak pohanchte jahan interferon antiviral proteins ke genes chalu karta; antiviral proteins aane wale virus ki afzaish rok dete.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.8: Doosre cells ko khabardar karne ka interferon nizam (kitab ki Figure 21.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Host cell 1 mein virus ghus kar naye viruses banata hai, lekin saath hi is cell ke interferon genes chalu ho jate hain aur interferon molecules bahar nikalte hain. Yeh host cell 2 tak pohanch kar us ke antiviral proteins ke genes chalu karte hain. Ab jab virus host cell 2 mein aata hai to antiviral proteins us ki replication (nayi copies banna) rok dete hain. Yani pehla cell khud to nahin bachta, magar parosi cells ko khabardar kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se protective proteins microbe par seedha hamla karte hain aur kaun se doosre cells ko khabardar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Complement proteins MAC bana kar microbe ki membrane mein seedha soorakh karte hain; interferons aas paas ke cells ko virus ke khilaf difa barhane ka paigham dete hain.

items: Complement system: liver ke 12 se zyada proteins tarteeb se fa'al hote hain; aakhri paanch MAC bana kar microbe phaar dete hain.
Interferons: virus-infected cells chhorte hain; yeh cytokines hain jo parosi cells ka anti-viral difa barhate aur NK cells aur macrophages ko fa'al karte hain.
